protocol.description: Append a UTF-8 value to a Redis string and return its new byte length.
protocol.name: redis_append
protocol.title: Append Redis String

protocol.description: Run a classified or explicitly unrestricted Redis request/response command. Connection-state, streaming, transaction, script, and blocking forms are rejected.
protocol.name: redis_command
protocol.title: Run Redis Command

protocol.description: Count keys in the selected Redis database.
protocol.name: redis_dbsize
protocol.title: Redis Database Size

protocol.description: Permanently delete one or more Redis keys. Requires full access.
protocol.name: redis_del
protocol.title: Delete Redis Keys

protocol.description: Count how many of the requested Redis keys currently exist.

keys.description: Redis keys. Between 1 and 1000 keys are accepted per call.

protocol.name: redis_exists
protocol.title: Check Redis Keys

protocol.description: Set a positive key expiration in seconds. Missing keys are reported without error.
protocol.name: redis_expire
protocol.title: Expire Redis Key

protocol.description: Create a HASH or JSON search index with TEXT, TAG, NUMERIC, or GEO fields.

alias.description: Query-facing field alias, strongly recommended for JSON indexes.

name.description: Hash field name or JSONPath expression.

noindex.description: Store the field without indexing it.

nostem.description: Disable stemming for a TEXT field.

sortable.description: Make the field available to SORTBY.

on.description: Data model to index: HASH (default) or JSON.

prefixes.description: Key prefixes to include. Empty means Redis's default prefix.

schema.description: Index field definitions, bounded to 100 fields.

protocol.name: redis_ft_create
protocol.title: Create Redis Search Index

protocol.description: Drop a search index. Optionally delete indexed documents too; requires full access.

delete_docs.description: Also delete all documents indexed by this index.

protocol.name: redis_ft_dropindex
protocol.title: Drop Redis Search Index

protocol.description: Read index schema, document counts, and indexing status. Requires the Search capability.
protocol.name: redis_ft_info
protocol.title: Inspect Redis Search Index

protocol.description: List Redis Query Engine indexes. Requires the Search capability.
protocol.name: redis_ft_list
protocol.title: List Redis Search Indexes

protocol.description: Run a bounded Redis Query Engine search. Pass page.continuation.offset as limit_offset until page.complete is true. Binary response values retain explicit encodings.

limit_num.description: Maximum results to return, bounded to 100 per call.

limit_offset.description: Result offset. Start with zero and follow page.continuation.offset.

query.description: Query expression. Use `*` to match all indexed documents.

withscores.description: Include match scores in the raw response sequence.

protocol.name: redis_ft_search
protocol.title: Search Redis Index

protocol.description: Read a Redis string value. Binary data is returned as base64.
protocol.name: redis_get
protocol.title: Get Redis String

protocol.description: Read one Redis hash field. Binary values are returned as base64.
protocol.name: redis_hget
protocol.title: Get Redis Hash Field

protocol.description: Read all fields and values in a Redis hash with binary-safe encodings. The configured output budget is enforced; use redis_hscan for large hashes.
protocol.name: redis_hgetall
protocol.title: Get Redis Hash

protocol.description: Read one bounded HSCAN page. Pass page.continuation.cursor as cursor until page.complete is true. Fields and values are binary-safe.

count.description: Approximate number of fields or members Redis should inspect.

cursor.description: Cursor returned by the previous page. Start with zero.

protocol.name: redis_hscan
protocol.title: Scan Redis Hash

protocol.description: Set between 1 and 1000 UTF-8 field-value pairs in a Redis hash.
protocol.name: redis_hset
protocol.title: Set Redis Hash Fields

protocol.description: Increment a Redis integer string by one and return the new value.
protocol.name: redis_incr
protocol.title: Increment Redis Integer

protocol.description: Read Redis server information and statistics, optionally for one INFO section.

section.description: Optional INFO section, such as server, memory, stats, or replication.

protocol.name: redis_info
protocol.title: Redis Server Info

protocol.description: Delete JSON values at a path. Deleting the root removes the key and requires full access.

key.description: Redis key containing the JSON document.

path.description: JSONPath expression. Defaults to the document root.

protocol.name: redis_json_del
protocol.title: Delete Redis JSON

protocol.description: Read the JSON value at a path. Requires RedisJSON; the default path is `$`.

key.description: Redis key containing the JSON document.

path.description: JSONPath expression. Defaults to the document root.

protocol.name: redis_json_get
protocol.title: Get Redis JSON

protocol.description: Set a structured JSON value at a path. Requires RedisJSON; NX and XX are optional conditions.

key.description: Redis key to create or update.

nx.description: Store only when the key or path does not exist.

path.description: JSONPath expression. Defaults to the document root.

value.description: JSON value. Pass structured JSON directly rather than a JSON-encoded string.

xx.description: Store only when the key or path already exists.

protocol.name: redis_json_set
protocol.title: Set Redis JSON

protocol.description: Read JSON value types at a path. Requires RedisJSON; JSONPath may match multiple values.

key.description: Redis key containing the JSON document.

path.description: JSONPath expression. Defaults to the document root.

protocol.name: redis_json_type
protocol.title: Get Redis JSON Type

protocol.description: Push between 1 and 1000 UTF-8 elements to the head of a Redis list.

elements.description: UTF-8 elements to push to the head in argument order.

protocol.name: redis_lpush
protocol.title: Push Redis List Elements

protocol.description: Read a bounded inclusive range from a Redis list. Defaults to ranks 0 through 99. Follow page.continuation.start until page.complete is true. Binary elements are base64.

stop.description: Inclusive stop index. Negative indexes address from the end.

protocol.name: redis_lrange
protocol.title: Read Redis List Range

protocol.description: Read the number of bytes a Redis key and its value require in memory.
protocol.name: redis_memory_usage
protocol.title: Redis Key Memory Usage

protocol.description: Read multiple Redis string values atomically. Binary values are base64.

keys.description: Redis keys. Between 1 and 1000 keys are accepted per call.

protocol.name: redis_mget
protocol.title: Get Multiple Redis Strings

protocol.description: Atomically store between 1 and 1000 UTF-8 key-value pairs.
protocol.name: redis_mset
protocol.title: Set Multiple Redis Strings

protocol.description: Remove a key expiration. Missing or already-persistent keys report false.
protocol.name: redis_persist
protocol.title: Persist Redis Key

protocol.description: Test the configured Redis connection and report round-trip latency.
protocol.name: redis_ping
protocol.title: Ping Redis

protocol.description: Return one random key, or null when the selected database is empty.
protocol.name: redis_randomkey
protocol.title: Random Redis Key

protocol.description: Add between 1 and 1000 UTF-8 members to a Redis set.
protocol.name: redis_sadd
protocol.title: Add Redis Set Members

protocol.description: Read one bounded non-blocking SCAN page. Pass page.continuation.cursor as cursor until page.complete is true.

count.description: Approximate number of keys Redis should inspect in this page.

cursor.description: Cursor returned by the previous scan. Start with zero.

protocol.name: redis_scan
protocol.title: Scan Redis Keys

protocol.description: Set a UTF-8 Redis string, optionally with an expiration.
protocol.name: redis_set
protocol.title: Set Redis String

protocol.description: Read all Redis set members in deterministic byte order. The configured output budget is enforced; use redis_sscan for large sets. Binary members are base64.
protocol.name: redis_smembers
protocol.title: Read Redis Set

protocol.description: Read one bounded SSCAN page. Pass page.continuation.cursor as cursor until page.complete is true. Members are binary-safe.

count.description: Approximate number of fields or members Redis should inspect.

cursor.description: Cursor returned by the previous page. Start with zero.

protocol.name: redis_sscan
protocol.title: Scan Redis Set

protocol.description: Read a Redis string length in bytes. Missing keys have length zero.
protocol.name: redis_strlen
protocol.title: Redis String Length

protocol.description: Read a key TTL in seconds, including whether it is missing or persistent.
protocol.name: redis_ttl
protocol.title: Redis Key TTL

protocol.description: Read the Redis data type of a key.
protocol.name: redis_type
protocol.title: Redis Key Type

protocol.description: Asynchronously unlink one or more Redis keys. Requires full access.

keys.description: Redis keys. Between 1 and 1000 keys are accepted per call.

protocol.name: redis_unlink
protocol.title: Asynchronously Delete Redis Keys

protocol.description: Add or update scored UTF-8 members in a Redis sorted set.

ch.description: Report both added and changed members.

gt.description: Update only when the new score is greater.

lt.description: Update only when the new score is less.

members.description: Score-member pairs to add or update.

protocol.name: redis_zadd
protocol.title: Add Redis Sorted Set Members

protocol.description: Read a bounded rank range from a Redis sorted set, optionally with scores. Defaults to ranks 0 through 99. Follow page.continuation.start until page.complete is true.

stop.description: Inclusive stop rank. Negative indexes address from the end.

protocol.name: redis_zrange
protocol.title: Read Redis Sorted Set Range

protocol.description: Read one bounded ZSCAN page. Pass page.continuation.cursor as cursor until page.complete is true. Members are binary-safe and include scores.

count.description: Approximate number of fields or members Redis should inspect.

cursor.description: Cursor returned by the previous page. Start with zero.

protocol.name: redis_zscan
protocol.title: Scan Redis Sorted Set
